text: Hi all, can we start next week's practice 15 min earlier? 19:15 instead of 19:30?
Monday? I get off at 6 but the shop is 25 min from the hall with traffic. 19:15 is tight but ok
Ya fine for me, my last class ends at 6 on Mondays 🙂
I can make 19:15. The after-school club runs till 5:30 so I'll drive straight over
I can do 19:15 probably. Camp goes till 5:30 and then the bus is like 20 min
Great. Hao-Ran if you're late just start without you lol
Ha ok. I'll try
Earlier is fine with me. Does anyone have the Rutter score? Mine is missing a page
I have a scan of pp 12-14 if you want
[photo: pages 12-14 of the Rutter score]
Ah good, thanks
Who's doing the tenor line for the second verse? I don't remember how it goes
I think its the same as the first one but an octave down?
Yeah I think so. Check the recording on the drive, I uploaded it last week
Found it. Thanks
Is the Rutter in D or E-flat? The scan doesn't say
E-flat. Three flats in the key sig on p1. The scan cuts it off
Thank you. I had D written in mine, I must have copied it wrong
Sorry late, car came in at 6 and the shop's been slammed
Ok thanks Yu-Cheng IMSLP says D tho, maybe different edition
[photo: my score with pp 12-14 taped in]
Nice!!
Monday hall is the usual room right? Yu-Cheng do you have the key or should I get it
I have it. I'll be there by 7 and leave the side door open
Thx
Bus is late again. Might be 10 min late for the 19:15 thing
Anyone know if the Rutter has a piano reduction
Yes, in the blue folder on the shelf. Gwei-Hua knows where it is
Prod broke at 4, took forever. Fixed now. Going to sleep
Ok I'll just print the E-flat one then
Morning. Prod is holding so far 🤞
Morning. Shop is open half day so I'm in till 1
Yu-Cheng has a school concert this morning, he'll be back after lunch. I'm home if anyone needs anything for Monday
Bus was late again lol. Ok I'll be there monday
Printed the E-flat one at the school library. The printer ate a page and I had to redo p13
Oof. Good you caught it
Does anyone know if the chairs are already out in the hall or do we set them up ourselves
Chairs are stacked in the storage room, we set up. Took about 20 min last time
We'll drive in together. I'll help with the chairs
Ok. Shop was fine. Bought a bike light and now I want to ride again lol
Anyone still awake
Me. About to sleep soon though. Printed score is in my bag
Can't sleep lol. The tenor line is still stuck in my head, I keep humming it an octave down
